g.title: G
g.text: S = Agent || Monitor. The agent is session 11's buggy agent, untouched. The monitor is one bit: was the previous step `ask`?
A state of S is a pair (step, fresh). The shortcut still exists -- it leads to (act, F), where the gateway REFUSES the delete.
